title: Company

help.title: About Company
help.overview: This page manages the current tenant's company record, not a list of companies. Use Edit to open the company form.

sections.title: Company details
items: Name and VAT are required. Email, phone, website, social links, description, logo, and allowed domains are optional.
Each added address requires street, postal code, city, country, and map coordinates; state or canton is optional.

sections.title: Public AI chat
items: Enable or disable the visitor bot and set its greeting and persona.
Choose whether visitors must identify themselves and whether human handoff is available. These settings feed Website chats.

sections.title: Company status
items: Activate or deactivate this company only when it has a parent company.

failTitleTooltip: Click to retry loading company info
